HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
